skill.description: Guidelines for building Next.js 15 frontends with React 19, TypeScript, Shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Server Components, and the App Router.
skill.summary: Build modern Next.js 15 frontends with practical React, TypeScript, Shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS guidance.
skill.author: 0Chan-smc

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, placeholder example code, or JSX snippets. No prompt injection, malicious intent, credential access, command execution, or real network behavior was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - [ ] Add `"use client"` directive only if needed (interactivity, hooks, browser APIs)
- **Server Components** (default): No `"use client"`, can fetch data directly, smaller bundle
- **Client Components**: Add `"use client"` for interactivity, hooks, browser APIs
- No need for `useEffect` or data fetching libraries
- Customize via `className` prop or CSS variables
2. **App Router Structure**: Use file-based routing with `app/` directory
8. **Import Aliases**: Use `@/` prefix for clean imports

content.user_title: Build Next.js Frontends With Modern Patterns
content.value_statement: Modern Next.js projects need consistent patterns for components, routing, data fetching, and styling. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical frontend guidance for React 19 and Next.js 15.
actual_capabilities: Guides Server Component and Client Component decisions for Next.js 15 applications.
Explains App Router file organization for pages, layouts, loading states, and error states.
Shows patterns for Server Component data fetching and Server Actions.
Recommends Shadcn/ui imports, Tailwind CSS usage, and the cn utility.
Provides TypeScript, performance, image, font, and Suspense guidance for frontend work.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not execute project-specific checks by itself.
It focuses on Next.js 15 App Router projects, not older Pages Router applications.
Example APIs and data models are placeholders and must be adapted before use.
It does not replace a full accessibility, security, or production readiness review.

use_cases.title: Create Feature Pages
use_cases.description: Plan a new App Router page with components, loading UI, error handling, and data fetching patterns.

use_cases.title: Standardize Component Work
use_cases.description: Apply consistent Server Component, Client Component, TypeScript, Shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS conventions.

use_cases.title: Review Frontend Architecture
use_cases.description: Check whether a Next.js feature follows modern file organization, performance, and typing practices.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new route.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-dev-guidelines skill to plan a Next.js 15 page for a posts list with loading and error states.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Component Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-dev-guidelines skill to decide which parts of this feature should be Server Components or Client Components.

prompt_templates.title: Design Data Mutations
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for form and mutation patterns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-dev-guidelines skill to design a form flow with validation, Server Actions, and Shadcn/ui form components.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Feature Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-dev-guidelines skill to review my Next.js feature plan for routing, file organization, performance, and TypeScript issues.

output_examples.input: Create a product list route with loading and error states.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend an App Router page, a loading file, an error boundary, feature components, and Server Component data fetching.

output_examples.input: Review this interactive form component plan.
output_examples.output: The skill would check Client Component requirements, typed props, validation, Server Actions, Shadcn/ui usage, and Tailwind class organization.

output_examples.input: Improve performance for a dashboard page.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest Server Components, Suspense boundaries, optimized images, font handling, and careful use of client hooks.

best_practices: Start with Server Components, then add Client Components only for interaction, hooks, or browser APIs.
Keep route files, feature components, Server Actions, and shared UI in clear App Router locations.
Use TypeScript, Shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and the cn utility consistently across frontend code.
anti_patterns: Adding use client to every component without checking whether browser APIs or hooks are needed.
Mixing route logic, shared UI, feature code, and data mutations in one unstructured folder.
Copying placeholder API URLs or example data models into production without adapting them.

faq.question: What projects is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for Next.js 15 applications that use React 19, TypeScript, Shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and the App Router.

faq.question: Does this skill execute commands?
faq.answer: No. It is a Markdown guidance skill with examples. It does not require shell commands or local execution.

faq.question: Can it help choose Server Components or Client Components?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when to default to Server Components and when client-side interactivity requires a Client Component.

faq.question: Does it include data fetching guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Server Component data fetching, Server Actions, caching notes, and mutation patterns.

faq.question: Can it replace project-specific review?
faq.answer: No. It provides general patterns, but teams still need review for their architecture, security, accessibility, and requirements.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Claude Code, and Codex.
